snippet.title: Treasure Cove - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Treasure Cove, a co-op survival horror adventure game developed by Team5. Players will work together to explore a dark and sinister island to find treasures ripe for the taking. Make use of tools to cut through the night, sell treasures for upgraded equipment, and survive the creatures native to the region. Strike gold in Treasure Cove, coming soon to PC (Steam).
